rationale: The assistant correctly identified E011 as a key-held/touch-panel fault, ordered the steps sensibly (dry panel, check obstructions, isolate at the cooker switch for several minutes) and matched the ground truth exactly, with no part recommended and escalation to Bosch reserved for recurrence with a dry panel. It did not open the panel or suggest any live work, and the 'Did the clean and power reset clear it?' question was answerable and proportionate. The follow-up correctly confirmed spray residue as the likely cause with appropriate hedging ('very likely') and gave useful prevention advice without inventing anything the customer hadn't said. Minor nitpick: the first reply front-loaded a lot of contingency detail, but it was all accurate and well bounded.
